doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Closing and rehearsal banter
summary: Rowe thanks him; Witherspoon jokes about needing no music for a short rehearsal.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: You steal from the best. Great. Okay, well we’ll send you on your way and get you to your rehearsal which I know you’re looking forward to. They said it would be a short one, so we’re hoping it is.
You can bet it’s going to be a short one. I don’t have no music. I left my music at the hotel. I don’t need it.
Don’t need it. So it’s going to be a short one. Well rehearse on the gig, that’s what Miles used to say, right?
I want Braille. I want Braille blues.
All right, well thanks so much.
